coverage_notes: Every supplied observation and CRA row was considered. Every registered anchor page, including secondary locations, was actually viewed. shared_qualifications: Source Table1 independently identifies the annealed UNS S30100 substrate (PDF p.2). Table2 distinguishes implanted sample9 (140 keV,3.10*10^16 retained Mo ions/cm2) from sample10 (140 keV,5.55*10^16), PDF p.4. Implant dose is not converted to a bulk Mo wt%.

Fig.3 labels apparent critical pitting Ec on the forward polarization characteristics; the authors emphasize its poor reproducibility and no consistent beneficial Ec shift (PDF pp.4-5). The labeled transitions were visually enlarged; no extra onset was traced from unannotated curves.

The500 mV(SCE) chloride-addition holds (control and sample9) produce only upper limits on pitting threshold. They are distinct from the scanned control/sample10 outcomes represented by the two CRA rows. V(SCE)*1000=mV(SCE), without a reference offset.

CRA25 C and any numerical scan rate are not independently supplied by the inspected source electrochemical passages. The text specifies room-temperature implantation, which is not automatically the test temperature.

observations.notes: This control result is an upper limit from a500 mV(SCE) hold with chloride added after30 min (PDF pp.4-5). CRA566 is identified with the separate scanned Ec transition; the hold endpoint is not that measured threshold.

This upper limit is from the chloride-addition hold on sample9 (3.10*10^16 Mo ions/cm2), not the scanned sample10 dose5.55*10^16 represented by CRA567. Both specimen and protocol differ; no counterpart is supplied.
